title: Driscoll essay on AI-native company intelligence layer with Ramp/Cerebras refs
summary: Michael Driscoll amplifies Lieberman's AI-native company feature #3—a centralized queryable intelligence layer—with a Da Vinci collage diagram and links to Ramp, Cerebras, and Anthropic data-agent write-ups.
question_it_answers: How are Ramp, Cerebras, and Anthropic framing the centralized agent intelligence layer?

claims.text: Defines feature #3 as a centralized intelligence layer aggregating structured and unstructured data for agentic work.
claims.evidence: Centralized intelligence layer that aggregates structured and unstructured data, documents, and business logic into a single source of truth
